handRendering.style: artist-edited floating grip with a short cuff

playback.alpha: 0 or 255; replacement pixels use opaque black / warm gray; never additive blending.
playback.cancel: Discard operation overlay; retain original persistent state.
playback.finish: Atomically replace cumulative patch with destination patch and clear operation delta, then start destination idle.
playback.hand: At most one working hand. One static grip per tool; positions are tweened, with local surface patches and contact particles. No supporting hand. Table props stay in place.
playback.idle: base + cumulative state patch + idle frame delta
playback.mouth: Approved reference mouth is preserved. Lipstick and lip-outline additions were removed after review.
playback.operation: freeze idle at phase 0; base + from-state patch + operation frame delta
playback.timing: All frames use full canvas and fixed origin. Aseprite and JSON frame durations are milliseconds.
